seo_title: KZM — mod launcher for Katana ZERO
seo_description: KZM is a free mod launcher for Katana ZERO on Windows. Install .kzm packages, manage mod profiles, and launch the game from one app. Docs for mod authors included.
seo_keywords: Katana ZERO, mods, KZM, launcher, modding, Windows, Askiisoft, mod install
seo_og_description: Mod launcher for Katana ZERO: install mods, profiles, and play from one window.
seo_og_image_alt: Zero at the bar in Katana ZERO
bar_aria: Bar from Katana ZERO. NULL sits at the counter and sometimes drinks; patrons talk and smoke.

hero_detail: Mods for Katana ZERO — install, profiles, and launch from one launcher.
about_intro: New characters, mechanics, and stories start with mods. KZM brings the workflow together — from installing a package to launching Katana ZERO.
step1_body: Select your Katana ZERO folder and complete the one-time setup. The launcher keeps a backup of your game data.
step2_body: Drop a .kzm into the import folder or install through the launcher. Enable mods and save your loadout in a profile.
step3_body: KZM applies your mods and starts the game. Switch profiles for a different loadout.
about_compat: KZM requires a legally owned copy of Katana ZERO. We do not support piracy. Game version and mod compatibility are listed in each mod’s description.
resources_intro: Play, build something new, or support the project.
